"I'll do it later."

It's something we've all said.

I'll organize those receipts later.

I'll reconcile the accounts later.

I'll hire a bookkeeper when the business gets bigger.

I'll deal with taxes when tax season gets closer.

problem.

owners who didn't struggle because they lacked opportunities—they struggled because they waited too long to organize the financial

Closing deals.
